init.title: External snapshots
init.description:
Use images from an external detector as thumbnails. If a snapshot was taken while a recording ran, it is used instead of the first video frame. Leave the directory empty to disable.

Directory placeholders: {fields}. Example: `{directory_example}`
File name pattern example: `{pattern_example}`

data_description.snapshot_directory: Absolute path. The date placeholder accepts a date format, as in the example above.
data_description.snapshot_pattern: Matched against the whole file name. Supports %Y %y %m %d %H %M %S %f (Home Assistant time zone), %s (Unix timestamp) and the wildcards * and ?.
data_description.snapshot_tolerance: Also accept snapshots taken this many seconds before the start or after the end of a recording.

error.invalid_directory: Invalid directory: use an absolute path and only the listed placeholders.
error.invalid_pattern: Invalid pattern: it must contain %s or a complete date and time (%Y or %y, %m, %d, %H, %M).
